title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell

ai_review.summary: Stellar 1970 performance with standout Cryptical Envelopment → Cosmic Charlie, captured on a decent soundboard source despite occasional cuts and low‑bass quirks.
ai_review.review: Fans hail this May 2 1970 show as one of the band’s finest, especially praising the acoustic set and the soaring sequence of Cryptical Envelopment into Cosmic Charlie (often called “VLB”). The soundboard recording is generally good, though reviewers note a few cuts, occasional low‑bass issues, and other minor glitches that don’t detract from the overall excitement.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star praise for the musical performance outweighs modest technical complaints; many reviews highlight the same standout songs, indicating strong consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Some listeners mention cuts, mistakes and a low‑bass (VLB) issue, but overall the mix is clear enough to enjoy the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set praised as a folk‑high point, followed by an electric second half that builds to the explosive Cryptical → Cosmic Charlie sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone and improvisational fire are repeatedly lauded, especially on the VLB (The Other One) segment.
